fields.label: Chain Name
fields.help: Creates the new snapshot in the snapshot chain labeled with the specified name.

fields.label: Deletion Policy
fields.help: Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance.

fields.label: Description
fields.help: An optional description of this resource.

fields.label: Name
fields.help: Name of the resource; provided by the client when the resource is created.

fields.label: Snapshot Type
fields.help: Indicates the type of the snapshot.

fields.label: Source Disk
fields.help: A reference to the disk used to create this snapshot.

fields.label: Source Instant Snapshot
fields.help: A reference to the instant snapshot used to create this snapshot.

fields.label: Storage Locations
fields.help: Cloud Storage bucket storage location of the snapshot (regional or multi-regional).

fields.label: Zone
fields.help: A reference to the zone where the disk is hosted.

fields.label: Params
fields.help: Additional params passed with the request, but not persisted as part of resource payload

fields.label: Snapshot Encryption Key
KMS Key Self Link
fields.help: The name of the encryption key that is stored in Google Cloud KMS.

fields.label: KMS Key Service Account
fields.help: The service account used for the encryption request for the given KMS key.

fields.label: Raw Key
fields.help: Specifies a 256-bit customer-supplied encryption key, encoded in RFC 4648 base64 to either encrypt or decrypt this resource.

fields.label: Rsa Encrypted Key
fields.help: Specifies an encryption key stored in Google Cloud KMS, encoded in RFC 4648 base64 to either encrypt or decrypt this resource.
Encrypts the snapshot using a customer-supplied encryption key.

fields.label: Source Disk Encryption Key
KMS Key Self Link
fields.help: The name of the encryption key that is stored in Google Cloud KMS.

fields.label: KMS Key Service Account
fields.help: The service account used for the encryption request for the given KMS key.

fields.label: Raw Key
fields.help: Specifies a 256-bit customer-supplied encryption key, encoded in RFC 4648 base64 to either encrypt or decrypt this resource.

fields.label: Rsa Encrypted Key
fields.help: Specifies an encryption key stored in Google Cloud KMS, encoded in RFC 4648 base64 to either encrypt or decrypt this resource.
The customer-supplied encryption key of the source snapshot.
